description: Source code implementing shell utility functions for command parsing, string conversion, device lookup, and command management in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: shell_strtol
methods.description: Converts string to long integer with error handling.

methods.name: shell_strtoul
methods.description: Converts string to unsigned long with error handling.

methods.name: shell_strtoull
methods.description: Converts string to unsigned long long with error handling.

methods.name: shell_strtobool
methods.description: Converts string to boolean value based on common true/false strings.

methods.name: shell_device_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a device by index and optional prefix.

methods.name: z_shell_cmd_get
methods.description: Retrieves a command entry by parent and index.

methods.name: shell_set_root_cmd
methods.description: Sets the root command based on a command string.

methods.name: z_shell_spaces_trim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: z_shell_cmd_trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from command buffer in shell context.

methods.name: z_shell_find_cmd
methods.description: Finds a command matching a pattern within a parent command.

methods.name: z_shell_get_last_command
methods.description: Gets the last matched command in command parsing.

methods.name: z_shell_pattern_remove
methods.description: Removes a pattern substring from a buffer.

methods.name: z_shell_make_argv
methods.description: Parses command string into argument vector, handling quotes.

methods.name: line_num_with_buffer_offset_get
methods.description: Calculates line number based on buffer position.

methods.name: col_num_with_buffer_offset_get
methods.description: Calculates column number based on buffer position.

methods.name: z_column_span_with_buffer_offsets_get
methods.description: Calculates column span between two buffer offsets.

methods.name: z_row_span_with_buffer_offsets_get
methods.description: Calculates row span between two buffer offsets.

methods.name: z_shell_multiline_data_calc
methods.description: Calculates cursor position and extents for multiline shell input.
